purpose: Acquire offer-specific official evidence for the 10 Batch 19 HELD candidates without weakening the R2 provenance gate.
source_policy: Use only first-party official offer detail pages, official terms pages, or first-party structured APIs whose response explicitly contains the offer.
A source must explicitly bind title, price or benefit, conditions, validity or recurrence, and Da Nang applicability for the candidate to pass.
A legal footer, generic store locator, homepage catalog, current calendar year, brand presence, image filename, alt text alone, or historic address may not establish offer locality or validity.

Capture original response bytes, requested URL, final URL, status, UTC timestamp, headers, SHA-256 and soft-404/challenge detection. No mock, OCR-only, social repost or third-party aggregator authority.
Replay each candidate through the J358-R2 validator and return actual VERIFIED/HELD counts. Zero VERIFIED is an acceptable truthful outcome.
Do not rewrite old R1/R2 artifacts; place all acquisitions and outputs in new R3 directories with SHA-256 sidecars.
required_negative_controls: Reject a source that contains the price but not the offer title.
Reject a source that lists a Da Nang store but does not state the offer applies there.
Reject a source with an undated or expired promotion when the displayed claim asserts current validity.
Reject source-hash drift and soft-404 redirects.
acceptance_gate: CEO review required; no automatic promotion
